sources.title: GitHub - heyongxin233/DeTeCtive: [NeurIPS 2024] DeTeCtive: Detecting AI ...
sources.snippet: DeTeCtive addresses these challenges with a multi-level contrastive learning framework, distinguishing nuanced writing styles to improve detection accuracy across various domains and models. This repository contains the code and models from our paper, DeTeCtive: Detecting AI-generated Text via Multi-Level Contrastive Learning.
